gallery.description: Three tethered balloons are released and rise or sink by their buoyancy; a 1.5 m/s wind starts at 2.0 s.
A ball is launched into a pile of blocks.
A thin plate is released above a ball and falls under air drag that depends on its orientation.
A gripper throws a ball that a central attractor then pulls onto a curved path.
A ball is pushed into a cluster of balls, which scatter (cue ball material changed from wood to plastic).
A ball is pushed into a set of pins (ball material changed from rubber to wood).
A piston pushes a four-wheeled cart with cargo toward a spring buffer.
A ball is dropped into a heap of grains, which scatter over the floor (ball mass doubled).
A ball and a hoop race down a ramp to a backstop (the third racer, a cylinder, is removed in this branch).
A 38 kg cabinet is tipped over and sheds the books and the vase on it.
The first chair of a row is pushed at the top of its back and the row falls like dominoes.
A spring-loaded plunger is let go and fires a ball into a tower of blocks (ball mass x0.6).
A pendulum is released into a tower of 18 blocks; an extra impulse hits the bob at 1.0 s.
A table is tipped over and the items on it slide off.
A row of nine books on a table is toppled; the last book sends a ball off the edge into a box.
An armchair is pushed into a table (gravity x0.6).
A chair is thrown onto a table.
A crate is released above a small table and lands on it (crate material changed from wood to plastic).
Two masses joined by two springs are displaced and let go, and oscillate together.
A double pendulum swings (gravity x0.6).
A ball is released above an elastic net of linked panels and bounces off it.
A mass on a spring is released and oscillates (empty room).
A ball released at the top of a ramp hits a spring-mounted bumper, which topples a row of dominoes.
A trigger pin is pulled and a spring-driven arm throws a ball (spring stiffness halved).
A piston presses one end of a lever down and the cargo on the other end is thrown up.
Two tyres roll toward one another, collide and knock over two stacks of boxes.
A ball is launched into a curved track and follows it around.

gallery_note: PhysX recordings of 27 of the 56 motion families, path-traced and cropped to the action. The orange arm is a drawing that follows the recorded end effector. Each caption states the branch of the record where it is not the factual run.
